Help finding alternate names for “chowder” and tips on converting it to an instant pot
My family used to make a vegetable soup we called a “chowder.” It was essentially all sorts of veggies from the garden (corn, green beans, tomatoes, etc) and also beef and chicken. We cooked it in a big cast iron pot outside over an open fire and took turns stirring it for hours with a wooden oar/paddle. Does anyone have a different name for this “chowder” or have ideas for making it in an instant pot? My concern is that I can’t stir it constantly in an instant pot, and that’s what really broke everything apart to make it the right consistency.
